items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I said, man, what you do with that thing on? He said, I'm with Paul.

ctx.x: I came back here and I have, as usual, two, three jobs. One of them was with Whirline repair department. I took Charlie and repair department. And what were we talking about?
We're talking about Paul Whiteman and Roy Maxwell.

Oh yeah, Paul Whiteman. Well, Paul was playing in New Orleans that week that I'm talking about. And who do I see with the uniform on with Roy Maxwell? I said, man, what you do with that thing on? He said, I'm with Paul. I said, you're with Paul? He said, you have the back. Because he couldn't even read a note when we were at the service and everything. He just played like a spire. And when he said, well, I'll tell you. I said, well, how did you manage to do that? He said, well, I'll tell you what I did, girl. He…
